import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { EMPTY_STRING, MIN_INDEX } from '@src/constants';
import App from '@src/response-apps/storage/lock/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

// 支持的分类列表
const SUPPORTED_CATEGORIES = [
  // 一级分类
  '材料',
  '道具',
  '装备',
  '天工',
  '功法',
  // 材料子分类（带前缀，避免与道具子分类冲突）
  '材料-草药',
  '材料-经验材料',
  '材料-经验',
  '材料-其它',
  // 道具子分类（带前缀）
  '道具-丹药',
  '道具-其它'
];

/**
 * 解析锁定命令参数
 * /锁定 材料 -> 锁定所有材料
 * /锁定 材料 123 -> 锁定材料分类中ID为123的物品
 * /锁定 灵草 -> 锁定名为"灵草"的物品
 */
const parseLockCommand = (msg: string): string[] => {
  // 移除命令前缀，提取参数
  const args = msg.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?锁定\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();

  // 分割参数
  return args ? args.split(/\s+/) : [];
};

/**
 * 判断参数是否为支持的分类名
 */
const isSupportedCategory = (arg: string): boolean => {
  if (SUPPORTED_CATEGORIES.includes(arg)) {
    return true;
  }

  if (arg.startsWith('装备-')) {
    return SUPPORTED_CATEGORIES.includes('装备');
  }

  if (arg.startsWith('天工-')) {
    return SUPPORTED_CATEGORIES.includes('天工');
  }

  if (arg.startsWith('功法-')) {
    return SUPPORTED_CATEGORIES.includes('功法');
  }

  if (arg === '本命') {
    return true;
  }

  return false;
};

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    // uid 已由中间件验证并设置
    const uid = e.uid as number;

    // 解析命令参数
    const args = parseLockCommand(e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING);

    // 检查参数是否为空
    if (args.length === 0) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(
        [
          '❌ 参数错误',
          '使用方法:',
          '/锁定 [分类名/物品名]',
          '/锁定 [分类名] [物品ID]',
          '示例:',
          '/锁定 材料        ← 锁定所有材料',
          '/锁定 材料 123    ← 锁定材料分类中ID为123的物品',
          '/锁定 灵草        ← 锁定名为"灵草"的物品',
          '',
          `可用分类: ${SUPPORTED_CATEGORIES.join('、')}`
        ].join('\n')
      );

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const firstArg = args[0];
    const secondArg = args[1];
    const thirdArg = args[2];

    let result;

    // 先尝试将前两个参数拼接为复合分类（支持空格分隔，如 /锁定 道具 丹药 → 道具-丹药）
    // 但如果第二个参数是纯数字（物品ID），则不作为复合分类
    const isSecondArgNumeric = secondArg && !isNaN(Number(secondArg));
    const compoundCategory = secondArg && !isSecondArgNumeric ? `${firstArg}-${secondArg}` : null;
    const isCompound = compoundCategory && isSupportedCategory(compoundCategory);

    // 判断第一个参数是否为支持的分类名
    if (isCompound) {
      // 复合分类（如 道具 丹药 → 道具-丹药）
      const categoryName = compoundCategory;

      if (thirdArg) {
        const itemId = parseInt(thirdArg, 10);

        if (isNaN(itemId) || itemId < MIN_INDEX) {
          const md = Format.createMarkdown();

          md.addText(['❌ 参数错误', '', '物品ID必须是大于0的数字', '', '示例:', '/锁定 材料 123   ← 锁定材料分类中ID为123的物品'].join('\n'));

          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

          return;
        }

        const appResult = await App({ bid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e), uid, mode: 'id', category: categoryName, itemId });

        result = appResult.code === 'OK' ? appResult.data : { success: false, count: 0, message: appResult.data.message };

        if (result.success && result.count > 0) {
          const md = Format.createMarkdown();

          md.addText(['✅ 锁定成功', '', `分类: ${categoryName}`, `物品ID: ${itemId}`, result.message, '', '💡已锁定的物品无法被消耗或丢弃'].join('\n'));

          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        } else {
          const categoryParts = categoryName.split('-');
          const storageCommand = `/储物袋 ${categoryParts[0]} ${categoryParts[1]}`;
          const buttonLabel = `储物袋${categoryParts[1]}`;

          const md = Format.createMarkdown();

          md.addText(['❌ 锁定失败', '', `分类: ${categoryName}`, result.message, '', '点击按钮查看物品列表:'].join('\n'));

          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: buttonLabel, command: storageCommand }] }));
        }
      } else {
        const appResult = await App({ bid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e), uid, mode: 'category', category: categoryName });

        result = appResult.code === 'OK' ? appResult.data : { success: false, count: 0, message: appResult.data.message };

        if (result.success && result.count > 0) {
          const md = Format.createMarkdown();

          md.addText(['✅ 锁定成功', '', `分类: ${categoryName}`, `数量: ${result.count} 件`, '', '💡已锁定的物品无法被消耗或丢弃'].join('\n'));

          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        } else {
          const md = Format.createMarkdown();

          md.addText(
            ['⚠️ 锁定失败', '', `分类“${categoryName}”中没有可锁定的物品`, '', '可能原因:', '1. 该分类下没有物品', '2. 所有物品已经被锁定'].join('\n')
          );

          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        }
      }
    } else if (isSupportedCategory(firstArg)) {
      const categoryName = firstArg;

      // 如果有第二个参数（物品ID）
      if (secondArg) {
        const itemId = parseInt(secondArg, 10);

        // 验证物品ID
        if (isNaN(itemId) || itemId < MIN_INDEX) {
          const md = Format.createMarkdown();

          md.addText(['❌ 参数错误', '', '物品ID必须是大于0的数字', '', '示例:', '/锁定 材料 123   ← 锁定材料分类中ID为123的物品'].join('\n'));

          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

          return;
        }

        // 按 userItemId 锁定
        const appResult = await App({ bid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e), uid, mode: 'id', category: categoryName, itemId });

        result = appResult.code === 'OK' ? appResult.data : { success: false, count: 0, message: appResult.data.message };

        if (result.success && result.count > 0) {
          const md = Format.createMarkdown();

          md.addText(['✅ 锁定成功', '', `分类: ${categoryName}`, `物品ID: ${itemId}`, result.message, '', '💡已锁定的物品无法被消耗或丢弃'].join('\n'));

          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        } else {
          // 解析分类名，生成储物袋按钮
          const categoryParts = categoryName.split('-');
          const storageCommand = categoryParts.length > 1 ? `/储物袋 ${categoryParts[0]} ${categoryParts[1]}` : `/储物袋 ${categoryName}`;
          const buttonLabel = categoryParts.length > 1 ? `储物袋${categoryParts[1]}` : `储物袋${categoryName}`;

          const md = Format.createMarkdown();

          md.addText(['❌ 锁定失败', '', `分类: ${categoryName}`, result.message].join('\n'));
          md.addNewline();
          md.addText('点击按钮查看物品列表:');
          md.addNewline();

          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: buttonLabel, command: storageCommand }] }));
        }
      } else {
        // 如果只有分类名，按分类锁定所有
        const appResult = await App({ bid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e), uid, mode: 'category', category: categoryName });

        result = appResult.code === 'OK' ? appResult.data : { success: false, count: 0, message: appResult.data.message };

        if (result.success && result.count > 0) {
          const md = Format.createMarkdown();

          md.addText(['✅ 锁定成功', '', `分类: ${categoryName}`, `数量: ${result.count} 件`, '', '💡已锁定的物品无法被消耗或丢弃'].join('\n'));

          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        } else {
          const md = Format.createMarkdown();

          md.addText(
            ['⚠️ 锁定失败', '', `分类"${categoryName}"中没有可锁定的物品`, '', '可能原因:', '1. 该分类下没有物品', '2. 所有物品已经被锁定'].join('\n')
          );

          void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
        }
      }
    } else {
      // 按物品名锁定（将所有参数合并为物品名，支持空格）
      const itemName = args.join(' ');

      const appResult = await App({ bid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e), uid, mode: 'name', itemName });

      result = appResult.code === 'OK' ? appResult.data : { success: false, count: 0, message: appResult.data.message };

      if (result.success && result.count > 0) {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(['✅ 锁定成功', '', `物品: ${itemName}`, result.message, '', '💡已锁定的物品无法被消耗或丢弃'].join('\n'));

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
      } else {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(['❌ 锁定失败', '', result.message, '', '💡请检查物品名称是否正确'].join('\n'));

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('锁定物品失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, e.uid as number, '锁定物品', '锁定物品失败，请稍后再试或联系运营。', createBackendRequestContext(e));

    md.addText(failMsg);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});

export default response;
